# That's Just Good

> Do good together. See it add up. That's Just Good is a Dallas-Fort Worth brand founded in 2020 by Nick Marino Jr. that brings people together to do good through three pillars: Events, Technology and Media.

- Events: free community pop-up volunteer events, private team building impact events for companies, Nico Makes A Difference reading visits for schools and kids, and Impact Partners programs for companies.
- Technology: My Impact Hub, a platform for tracking volunteer hours, goals, awards and badges for students, groups and companies, with verified transcripts and an annual Impact Unwrapped recap. Free for individuals.
- Media: the That's Just Good Podcast hosted by Nick Marino Jr., and the Nico Makes A Difference children's book series.

Key facts:
- Team building Host Only pricing: $1,250 for 90 minutes, $1,500 for 120 minutes, $2,000 for up to 180 minutes.
- My Impact Hub pricing: Personal free; Verified Student $39 a year; Starter Group free; Group $19 a month; Group Plus $49 a month; Network $99 a month; Company plans from $99 a month. Currently taking a waitlist.
- Impact Partners (billed yearly): The Good Council $2,083 a month ($25,000 a year); Impact Build $7,500 one time; Impact Partner Core $3,333 a month ($40,000 a year); Impact Partner Growth $6,250 a month ($75,000 a year); Enterprise custom. That's Just Good does not run gift matching or donation programs.
- Contact: dogood@thatsjustgood.com. Based in Dallas-Fort Worth, Texas. Events anywhere.

## Pages

- [That's Just Good](https://thatsjustgood.com/): That's Just Good brings people together to do good: impact events for companies, schools and communities, the My Impact Hub platform, and a podcast and books in Dallas-Fort Worth.
- [Free Community Events](https://thatsjustgood.com/community): Free community pop-up events where neighbors come together to help a local cause. Get pop-up alerts or bring one to your neighborhood.
- [Team Building](https://thatsjustgood.com/team-building): Private, cause-driven team building events for companies and groups in Dallas-Fort Worth and beyond. Pick any cause and we handle setup, supplies and hosting.
- [School Reading Visits](https://thatsjustgood.com/kids): Nico Makes A Difference reading visits for schools, daycares, libraries and youth programs: a story, a conversation and a hands-on kindness activity.
- [For Companies](https://thatsjustgood.com/partners): Join the Corporate Good Council or hire That's Just Good to design and run your company's volunteer program, from team events to company-wide Days of Service.
- [Impact Hub](https://thatsjustgood.com/impact-hub): Track volunteer hours and goals for NHS chapters, clubs, Greek life, companies and students. Verified transcripts, awards, badges and an annual Impact Unwrapped. Join the waitlist.
- [Podcast](https://thatsjustgood.com/podcast): Nick Marino Jr. talks with founders, nonprofit leaders and everyday changemakers about doing good in their communities. Listen on Spotify, Apple and YouTube.
- [Books](https://thatsjustgood.com/books): Nico Makes A Difference is a children's book series by Nick Marino Jr. that shows kids helping others is something they can do right now. Bulk orders and school visits available.
- [About](https://thatsjustgood.com/about): Founded in 2020 by Nick Marino Jr., That's Just Good is a Dallas-Fort Worth events, technology and media brand that brings people together to do good.
- [Plan Your Team Building Event](https://thatsjustgood.com/plan): Plan a team building impact event in minutes: choose your cause, group size and date, see your price instantly, and lock in your date online.
- [Contact](https://thatsjustgood.com/contact): Book a team building impact event, a community pop-up or a school reading visit, ask about Impact Partners or the Impact Hub, or pitch a podcast guest.
